problem: Camera and actor deviations can leave the logged observation domain before RGB artifacts become obvious, while lateral distance alone cannot express scene-, camera-, actor-, or frontend-dependent support.
mechanism: A parameter-free support certificate combines nearest training-camera position, view angle, and projected observed LiDAR support; lower support should rank RGB/depth/cross-frontend failure within and across equal-distance cohorts.
existing_method_boundary: This is an analytic compiler/verifier baseline, not a new reconstruction or learned support network. If distance explains the result, the learned-support direction is rejected and V6 pivots to provenance/verifier evidence.
failure_ledger_fact: R3 plan requires support to predict downstream failure earlier than pure image quality and not be fully explained by camera distance.
minimum_experiment: Two development scenes, StreetGS and AD-GS, two frames per scene, six lateral offsets, sparse observation RGB/depth support, cross-frontend static/actor/boundary disagreement, plus registered actor edits.
expected_direction: Support invalidity has positive stable rank correlation with downstream error and exceeds absolute lateral distance by at least the frozen margin.
falsification_condition: Support Spearman is below 0.30, gain over distance is below 0.05, distance-residual Spearman is below 0.10, or ordering is not stable across both scenes/frontends.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090; sequential frontend workers; no training; target under 2 GPU-hours and 24,000 MiB peak

problem: A single support scalar cannot distinguish photometric, geometric, semantic and dynamic readiness; R3 already showed that scalar support adds no value over distance and can be falsely safe for frontend-specific geometry failure.
mechanism: Use provenance-aware task-conditioned validity: cross-frontend consistency for q_photo, logged geometry residual plus camera support for q_geometry, actor-boundary evidence plus actor observation denominator for q_semantic, and explicit unknown/abstain for q_dynamics when no independent dynamics verifier exists.
existing_method_boundary: This is a conservative development-benchmark qualification rule over frozen R3 evidence, not a learned confidence model or cross-domain calibration claim.
minimum_experiment: Compare V0 distance, V1 projected view support, V2 logged reconstruction residual, V3 R3 scalar support, and factorized q on all 48 R3 rows; report coverage, selective risk and false-safe per task and per scene.
expected_direction: Factorized validity reduces worst-case false-safe by at least 0.20 versus V3, has nonzero aggregate coverage for photo/geometry/semantic, and abstains on dynamics rather than declaring unsupported cases safe.
falsification_condition: Worst-case false-safe gain over V3 is below 0.20, any accepted factor exceeds 0.05 false-safe, photo/geometry/semantic aggregate coverage is below 0.08, or q_dynamics accepts any case without an independent dynamics verifier.
compute_budget: CPU-only; no training; under 5 minutes; no confirmation read

problem: Before introducing a generator, the compiler must show that an exact held-out oracle proposal can pass independent task checks, survive provenance-preserving bake, and expand the usable region; otherwise the representation, verifier, or bake path is the bottleneck.
mechanism: Create four deterministic observation-plane SceneIR patch pseudo-holes from frozen R3 renders, submit the held-out content as an observed oracle proposal, verify photo/geometry/semantic agreement against the held-out observation, bake accepted proposals only, and reject a matched corrupted decoy control.
existing_method_boundary: This is an oracle upper-bound integration benchmark over development pseudo-holes, not a generation result, dense novel-view ground truth claim, or confirmation calibration result.
minimum_experiment: Two development scenes, StreetGS and AD-GS, two frames, and four pseudo-hole types (missing route support, missing side view, disocclusion, actor removal hole): 32 oracle proposals plus 32 corrupted controls with per-case provenance, verifier decision, bake invariance, and usable-region metrics.
expected_direction: Oracle acceptance is at least 0.95, corrupted-control acceptance is at most 0.05, median masked photo error reduction and eligible depth error reduction are at least 0.90, every hole type gains at least 0.50 usable masked coverage, and pixels outside the bake mask remain byte-identical.
falsification_condition: Oracle acceptance below 0.95, corrupted-control acceptance above 0.05, either median error reduction below 0.90, any hole type usable-coverage gain below 0.50, provenance loss, or any outside-mask mutation.
compute_budget: CPU-only reuse of 80 hash-verified R3 renders; no training; under 10 minutes; no confirmation read

reason: The preregistered 32-case Cartesian denominator is not instantiable because scene-0048/StreetGS frame 52 and 57 have exactly zero actor_remove_all effect; four actor/disocclusion pseudo-holes therefore have zero evidence pixels.

problem: The oracle integration question remains unresolved, but actor-conditioned pseudo-holes require actual actor-edit evidence rather than an all-scene/frontend Cartesian assumption.
mechanism: Retain all route and side-view cases; for actor removal and disocclusion, require at least 256 pixels from the frozen union of dynamic opacity and measured base-versus-actor-removal change, recording ineligible combinations as structural ABSTAIN before any proposal score. Verify, bake, provenance, and decoy rules remain unchanged.
existing_method_boundary: This is an evidence-eligible oracle upper-bound development benchmark, not a generator result; structural abstentions are excluded from acceptance rates but reported in full.
minimum_experiment: Eight route cases and eight side-view cases over two scenes/two frontends/two frames, plus the six evidence-eligible cases for each of actor removal and disocclusion: 28 oracle proposals, 28 matched corrupted controls, and four explicit structural abstentions.
expected_direction: On the 28 eligible cases, oracle acceptance is at least 0.95, corrupted-control acceptance is at most 0.05, median masked photo and eligible-depth error reductions are at least 0.90, every hole type gains at least 0.50 usable coverage, provenance is exact, and outside-mask values remain exact.
falsification_condition: Eligible case count differs from 28, structural abstentions differ from four, or any original R7 gate fails on the eligible denominator.
compute_budget: CPU-only reuse of hash-verified R3 renders; no training; under 10 minutes; no confirmation read

problem: R7 proves only that exact oracle observation patches can be verified and baked; R8 must select one frozen, legally usable and single-3090-executable proposal generator without interpreting its raw output as accepted world content.
mechanism: Audit Big-LaMa, Stable Diffusion v1.5 Inpainting and FLUX.1-Fill at immutable revisions; execute every ungated 3090-feasible candidate twice on four frozen R7 pseudo-holes, enforce deterministic seed, finite/non-degenerate masked output and exact outside-mask overlay, then select one executable candidate by lower peak VRAM and latency before quality-arm testing.
existing_method_boundary: This is a frozen proposal-generator capability and resource study. It does not train or fine-tune a foundation model, does not bake unverified output, and does not claim geometric, semantic or dynamic correctness.
minimum_experiment: Three-candidate legal/access/resource audit; actual Big-LaMa and SD-v1.5 inference on four cases spanning two scenes, two frontends and four hole types, two repeats per case; FLUX.1-Fill remains audit-only if gated or outside the frozen single-card contract.
expected_direction: At least one ungated candidate completes all eight repeated inferences below 24,000 MiB and 120 seconds/case, produces finite nonzero masked proposals, and preserves outside-mask pixels exactly after overlay; select exactly one candidate and keep all outputs typed proposal.
falsification_condition: No candidate is executable within resource limits, any selected candidate has failed/nondeterministic/nonfinite/zero-change cases, outside-mask overlay mutates, or more than one candidate enters the formal method.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090 24GB; sequential candidates; no training; no confirmation read

problem: R8 proves Big-LaMa is deterministic and executable but provides no evidence that generated content is photographically, geometrically, semantically, or dynamically safe; verifier factors must earn entry into R10 independently.
mechanism: Generate one frozen Big-LaMa proposal for every one of the 28 evidence-eligible R7 pseudo-holes, then compare P0 accept-all against independent P1 held-out RGB, P2 frozen monocular depth aligned only on observed outside-mask support, P3 frozen Cityscapes dynamic-class segmentation on the 12 actor-evidence cases, and P4 strict temporal ABSTAIN. Never combine arms or bake proposals.
existing_method_boundary: Matched development pseudo-hole arm ablation only. Hidden observations score verifier behavior; proposal pixels remain generated and no arm result is a confirmation, dense novel-view, 3D consistency, or closed-loop safety claim.
minimum_experiment: 28 proposals over two scenes, two frontends, two frames and four hole types; P0/P1/P2 on all 28, P3 on 12 actor-evidence cases with 16 structural modality abstentions, P4 ABSTAIN on all 28; per-arm acceptance coverage, false-safe rate, P0 reduction, resource and non-target exactness.
expected_direction: An arm is independently valid only if acceptance coverage is at least 0.10, false-safe rate at most 0.10, false-safe reduction versus matched P0 at least 0.25, and non-target pixels remain exact. P4 must abstain on every case because no temporal proposal evidence exists.
falsification_condition: Denominator drift; any arm entering R10 without meeting all independent gates; any cross-arm decision in R9; non-target mutation; P4 acceptance; resource contract violation; training or confirmation read.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090 24GB; sequential frozen inference; peak below 8GB for verifier stage; under 15 minutes; no training; no confirmation read

problem: Big-LaMa passed resource capability but no independent verifier arm met the R9 quality gate; R8 already established SD-v1.5 as the only other ungated executable candidate, so generator quality rather than verifier thresholds is the next isolated variable.
mechanism: Replace Big-LaMa with the exact frozen SD-v1.5 inpainting candidate and repeat the identical 28-case P0/P1/P2/P3/P4 experiment. Keep hidden observations, verifier weights, preprocessing, truth definitions, thresholds, gates and structural abstentions unchanged; never select generators per case.
existing_method_boundary: Matched development pivot after a recorded generator-quality rejection. It is not a reopened R8 resource selection, cross-generator ensemble, threshold search, bake authorization, confirmation result or closed-loop safety claim.
minimum_experiment: One SD-v1.5 proposal for each of the same 28 evidence-eligible pseudo-holes; P0/P1/P2 on 28, P3 on the same 12 actor-evidence cases, P4 ABSTAIN on 28; same arm summaries and gates as H-R9-001.
expected_direction: At least one of P1/P2/P3 reaches acceptance coverage at least 0.10, false-safe rate at most 0.10 and reduction versus its matched P0 at least 0.25; P4 remains all ABSTAIN and outside-mask pixels remain exact.
falsification_condition: No arm passes all unchanged gates, denominator or threshold drift, any per-case generator mixing, non-target mutation, P4 acceptance, resource violation, training, bake or confirmation read.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090 24GB; 28 sequential SD inferences plus frozen verifiers; peak below 8GB; under 15 minutes; no training; no confirmation read

problem: Both frozen single-image inpainting candidates fail every independent verifier-arm gate, indicating missing evidence rather than insufficient generator capacity; the compiler should test an aligned evidence-conditioned proposal before considering factor fusion.
mechanism: For each eligible pseudo-hole, fill only the mask from the other frozen frontend at the exact same scene, frame and edit variant. Label the result reconstructed cross-frontend proposal, then run the unchanged P0/P1/P2/P3/P4 verifiers, truths and gates from H-R9-001/002. Do not use learned generation or choose source per case.
existing_method_boundary: Both frontends derive from the same frozen sensor support, so this tests reconstruction-consensus proposals, not new observation, generator quality, independent sensor ground truth, external route support, confirmation or bake readiness.
minimum_experiment: 28 deterministic cross-frontend proposals with bidirectional StreetGS↔AD-GS source assignment; P0/P1/P2 on 28, P3 on the same 12 actor-evidence cases and P4 ABSTAIN on 28; same thresholds and arm gate.
expected_direction: At least one of P1/P2/P3 reaches acceptance coverage at least 0.10, false-safe rate at most 0.10 and reduction versus matched P0 at least 0.25, with exact outside-mask preservation and all P4 cases abstaining.
falsification_condition: No arm passes unchanged gates, any source frontend selected post hoc, source frame/edit mismatch, denominator drift, non-target mutation, P4 acceptance, fusion, bake, training or confirmation read.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090 24GB; no learned generator; frozen depth/semantic verifier inference below 8GB and 15 minutes; no training; no confirmation read

problem: R9 independently validates photo and geometry arms for cross-frontend proposals but has not shown that their fusion yields a nonzero, false-safe-free verified region while preserving uncertainty for disagreements.
mechanism: Consume only R9-eligible P1 photo and P2 geometry decisions. ACCEPT only when both accept, REJECT only when both reject, and ABSTAIN on disagreement or missing selected-arm evidence. Semantic and dynamics validity remain explicit ABSTAIN; no new model inference or threshold tuning occurs.
existing_method_boundary: Matched development fusion over R9 cross-frontend reconstructed proposals. It does not add sensor evidence, claim semantic/dynamic validity, verify trajectory length, bake content, read confirmation data or establish closed-loop safety.
minimum_experiment: All 28 R9 cases with per-case factorized photo/geometry/semantic/dynamics validity, overall ACCEPT/ABSTAIN/REJECT, accepted mask area, P0 joint false-safe comparison, disagreement accounting and non-target invariance.
expected_direction: Acceptance coverage is at least 0.05, accepted false-safe rate is exactly 0, every ACCEPT is jointly photo-and-geometry safe, reduction versus joint P0 false-safe is at least 0.25, every P1/P2 disagreement becomes ABSTAIN and only P1/P2 are consumed.
falsification_condition: Zero or sub-0.05 acceptance coverage, any false-safe ACCEPT, any disagreement not ABSTAIN, consumption of P3/P4, non-target mutation, bake/training/confirmation read or source artifact drift.
compute_budget: CPU-only reuse of immutable R9 results; under 2 minutes; no GPU inference, training, bake or confirmation read

problem: R10 yields three false-safe-free photo+geometry ACCEPT proposals, but runtime use requires explicit typed assets with provenance and validity and must not silently convert a semantic/dynamics-abstained actor region into an actor asset.
mechanism: Convert accepted static route holes into sparse observation-plane chunks containing explicit y/x coordinates and uint8 RGB payload, provenance and factorized validity; reload each package exactly without a generator. For accepted actor/disocclusion holes require semantic and dynamics ACCEPT in addition to photo/geometry, otherwise emit bake ABSTAIN and create no actor/trajectory asset.
existing_method_boundary: Development observation-plane patch packaging only. Static chunks are reconstructed cross-frontend content, not new sensor observations or 3D Gaussians; no actor or trajectory is authorized without semantic/dynamics validity.
minimum_experiment: Account for all three R10 ACCEPT cases: exactly two static route chunks with exact reload and one factor-incomplete actor bake ABSTAIN; zero actor assets and zero trajectories; complete provenance/validity registries and runtime dependency audit.
expected_direction: Two static chunks are packaged and reload byte-exact; the actor case abstains; every R10 ACCEPT is accounted, source proposals remain immutable, provenance/validity are complete, and runtime package has no online generator dependency.
falsification_condition: Any R10 ACCEPT unaccounted, static chunk count differs from two, actor/trajectory baked despite missing factors, reload drift, provenance/validity loss, source mutation, generator runtime dependency, training or confirmation read.
compute_budget: CPU-only package construction under 2 minutes and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, generator inference, training or confirmation read

problem: R11 creates two reload-exact static observation-plane chunks, but has not shown that the same compiled package yields deterministic logged-support replay and stable downstream perception outputs.
mechanism: Apply every frozen R11 static chunk twice to the identical R9 sensor input, compare each RGB replay byte-for-byte with the frozen source proposal, and run the same frozen Cityscapes DeepLab model independently on every replay. Dynamic factors absent from the package remain typed ABSTAIN.
existing_method_boundary: Development static RGB LogSim scope only. Perception exactness measures repeat consistency, not semantic correctness. The package contains no trajectory, actor, event, calibration or collision state, so those factors cannot be counted as passes.
minimum_experiment: Two static chunks times two repeats; exact sensor replay to source, exact within-case replay hashes, exact semantic label hashes, immutable frozen inputs, bounded single-3090 inference, and explicit ABSTAIN for every unrepresented factor.
expected_direction: Both assets replay with zero RGB error and exact repeat hashes; frozen semantic labels are exact across repeats; no generator is used at runtime; all five unsupported dynamic/calibration factors remain ABSTAIN.
falsification_condition: Any RGB mismatch, repeat drift, semantic label drift, source mutation, runtime generator dependency, unsupported factor reported as valid, training, confirmation read, more than 4 GiB GPU peak or more than 300 seconds.
compute_budget: single RTX 3090 24GB; one frozen DeepLab load and four 512x288 forwards; below 4GB and 5 minutes; no training or confirmation read

problem: Static RGB LogSim passes, but the baked package does not represent actors, trajectories, events, calibration or collisions; R2 provides a separately frozen SceneIR conformance package with two explicit actors, two observed timestamps and one camera calibration that can test the dynamic replay interface without inventing missing evidence.
mechanism: Fresh-load the immutable ReConDrive SceneIR fixture twice. At both observed timestamps resolve each actor transform, apply it to the actor Gaussian means, record world centroids/AABBs/visibility/classes, derive deterministic pairwise AABB collision labels, and replay the camera calibration. Compare all factor hashes exactly across repeats; absent events remain ABSTAIN.
existing_method_boundary: Development conformance-fixture validation only, with no model inference or physical-accuracy claim. Collision outputs are deterministic AABB labels rather than ground truth; semantic outputs preserve actor class labels rather than pixel segmentation correctness.
minimum_experiment: Two actors with 819 primitives each, two timestamps, one calibrated camera and two fresh package loads; exact trajectory, actor world-state, calibration, semantic-label, collision-label and whole-replay hashes; event ABSTAIN and immutable source.
expected_direction: Every represented factor is byte-exact across the two fresh replays, expected denominators are preserved, event remains ABSTAIN, runtime stays CPU-only under 120 seconds and no confirmation data is read.
falsification_condition: Any denominator drift, package integrity failure, actor/trajectory/calibration/semantic/collision repeat mismatch, source mutation, event falsely reported as represented, training, confirmation read or wall-time breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only fresh loading and replay under 120 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, model inference, training or confirmation read

problem: The dynamic SceneIR conformance fixture passes but contains only two actors and two timestamps; real-scene evidence is needed before R12 can claim useful trajectory and collision replay coverage.
mechanism: Fresh-load the immutable StreetGS scene-0230 SceneIR package twice, replay all 23 actors across all 196 timestamps by transforming each actor's frozen local centroid and AABB corners, preserve actor class/visibility, and derive every pairwise AABB collision label. Compare factor and whole-replay hashes exactly.
existing_method_boundary: Development real-checkpoint scene functional consistency only. Actor classes are unknown, no sensor is represented, and collision labels are deterministic AABB outputs rather than physical ground truth; sensor calibration and events remain ABSTAIN.
minimum_experiment: 23 actors, 172264 total actor primitives, 196 timestamps, 4508 trajectory rows and two fresh package loads; exact trajectory, actor-state, semantic-label, collision-label and whole-replay hashes; source immutable and unsupported factors ABSTAIN.
expected_direction: All denominators and represented outputs are exact across repeats under 120 CPU seconds; no training or confirmation read; sensor calibration and event remain explicit ABSTAIN.
falsification_condition: Any denominator or package integrity drift, any supported-factor repeat mismatch, source mutation, unsupported factor falsely reported valid, training, confirmation read or wall-time breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only optimized centroid/AABB replay under 120 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, model inference, training or confirmation read

problem: R11's verified assets are observation-plane patches and therefore cannot yet support logged-route deviation. Their frozen depth and logged camera calibration may be sufficient to lift them into auditable sparse world-space chunks that retain nonzero utility under small route changes.
mechanism: Lift the two verified route chunks through frozen R9 depth and R3 camera calibration into world points, then nearest-pixel z-buffer them into six nonzero camera deviations per frame. Compare native reconstruction, Big-LaMa generator-only diagnostic, cross-frontend naive generation and V6 verify-bake against the frozen StreetGS cross-frontend truth proxy.
existing_method_boundary: Development cross-frontend proxy test, not novel-view ground truth. Lifted points are sparse sampled surfaces, not completed 3D Gaussians. Perception, planning, collision and temporal correctness remain ABSTAIN.
minimum_experiment: Two chunks, 12 case-deviations and all four baseline labels; exact repeat projections, world point/area accounting, photo MAE, geometry relative error, usable lateral route and matched R9 false-safe rates. At least two V6 case-deviations and a common 0.5m lateral offset must pass frozen 256-pixel/0.12-photo/0.30-geometry gates.
expected_direction: V6 yields nonzero world area, at least 0.5m common lateral route support, exact repeated projection, zero accepted false-safe and at least 0.25 false-safe reduction versus naive acceptance without mutating sources.
falsification_condition: No world-space payload, fewer than two passing case-deviations, common lateral support below 0.5m, any V6 false-safe, false-safe reduction below 0.25, repeat/source drift, unsupported metric reported valid, training, confirmation read or resource breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only lift and 48 matched metric rows under 180 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, training or confirmation read

problem: The first world lift is structurally valid but unusable because verifier-relative depth is not a metric transport coordinate. The frozen logged support already contains metric LiDAR depth aligned with the same camera and can replace only this invalid depth source.
mechanism: Rasterize frozen cam0 LiDAR samples into 512x288, choose the nearest metric sample for each pixel only within an 8-pixel radius, and lift the same two verified RGB chunks with the same camera calibration. Repeat the unchanged six deviations, four-method matrix and route/photo/geometry/false-safe gates.
existing_method_boundary: Development logged-LiDAR-supported sparse point lift with a bounded deterministic nearest fill, not surface completion or novel-view ground truth. All unsupported R13 metrics remain ABSTAIN.
minimum_experiment: Same two chunks, 12 case-deviations, 48 method rows and exact-repeat/source audits as H-R13-001. Only depth source changes; at least two V6 case-deviations and common 0.5m lateral support must pass the unchanged 256-pixel/0.12-photo/0.30-geometry gates.
expected_direction: Metric LiDAR produces physically scaled nonzero world area and at least 0.5m common lateral support, while V6 retains zero false-safe and at least 0.25 reduction versus naive acceptance.
falsification_condition: Same route/coverage/safety failures as H-R13-001, any LiDAR fill beyond 8 pixels, denominator drift, source mutation, unsupported metric promoted, training, confirmation read or resource breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only bounded LiDAR fill, lift and 48 matched metric rows under 180 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, training or confirmation read

problem: Metric point lifting supports 3m lateral and 2m forward routes but fails both 5m cases. The two adjacent verified keyframes may contain complementary world samples whose deterministic union increases off-route support without generation or target-view filtering.
mechanism: Union both frozen metric world chunks in one coordinate frame, deduplicate by deterministic 5cm voxels, and project the same fused chunk to every previously frozen route deviation. Compare fused V6 metrics to H-R13-002 single-keyframe metrics with unchanged photo, geometry and minimum-pixel thresholds.
existing_method_boundary: Development two-keyframe sparse point union only, not surface completion, continuous temporal validation, visibility filtering or new evidence. The H-R13-002 truth proxy and unsupported metrics are unchanged.
minimum_experiment: One fused chunk from both inputs, 12 route rows and exact repeat/source audits. Fused points must exceed either single chunk, retain at least 3m common lateral route, reduce mean 5m geometry error by at least 25%, and make both 5m cases pass unchanged gates.
expected_direction: Complementary keyframe support preserves all prior route passes and extends common lateral support from 3m to 5m without changing V6's zero false-safe policy.
falsification_condition: No point densification, route regression below 3m, sub-25% mean 5m geometry reduction, either 5m case still failing, repeat/source drift, target-view filtering, training, confirmation read or resource breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only 5cm voxel union and 12 projections under 180 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, training or confirmation read

problem: The frozen 5cm temporal union regresses the route because it has no target-view visibility constraint. The same frozen support package contains three-camera logged LiDAR that can reject source points contradicted by target-view observations without using evaluation truth.
mechanism: Keep each H-R13-002 metric world chunk unchanged. For every frozen target deviation, project all three logged LiDAR cameras into that target view and retain a world point only when its nearest observation is within 4 pixels and has at most 0.30 relative depth disagreement. StreetGS RGB/depth remains an evaluation-only proxy and never enters filtering.
existing_method_boundary: Development target-view observation filtering of sparse points, not generation, densification, union, target-RGB selection, surface completion or novel-view ground truth. Unsupported perception, planning, collision and temporal metrics remain ABSTAIN.
minimum_experiment: Two chunks and the same 12 deviations under unchanged 256-pixel, 0.12-photo and 0.30-geometry gates. Execute twice exactly, audit all source hashes, retain at least 3m common lateral route, make both 5m cases pass, and preserve inherited zero V6 false-safe.
expected_direction: Removing points contradicted by frozen target-view LiDAR preserves the accepted 3m route and converts both 5m geometry failures into passes without threshold or denominator changes.
falsification_condition: Common lateral support below 3m, either 5m case fails, missing target-view observations, repeat/source drift, any V6 false-safe, target truth used in filtering, training, confirmation read or resource breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only three-camera LiDAR projection, distance transform and 12 matched evaluations under 180 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, training or confirmation read

problem: R13 has verified sparse static route deviation only to a bounded 3m lateral/2m forward scope; the plan also requires actor add/remove, trajectory modification and traffic-density changes. The real scene-0230 SceneIR already exposes 23 typed actors over 196 timestamps and can test whether compilation updates all dependent replay and collision factors rather than only visual or visibility fields.
mechanism: Compile three deterministic typed edits on the frozen real SceneIR replay: remove collision-active actor_0017, translate actor_0017 by +20m world-x at every timestamp, and add a +1m world-x clone of isolated actor_0001 as a controlled density/collision stressor. Recompute actor states, trajectories, semantics and every timestamp's AABB collision dependency, while requiring all unaffected state and collision pairs to remain byte-exact.
existing_method_boundary: Development typed SceneIR functional conformance, not rendered sensor realism or physical collision ground truth. Native reconstruction and generator-only arms abstain because they have no typed edit state; the naive arm models accepting a superficial edit with stale dependent factors; V6 must update the complete dependency closure.
minimum_experiment: Three edits times four method arms, two exact compilation repeats, frozen source hashes, exact actor/trajectory/collision denominators, unchanged-factor hashes, collision dependency recomputation, temporal coverage at all 196 timestamps, V6 3/3 ACCEPT with zero false-safe and naive 3/3 false-safe.
expected_direction: V6 is the only arm that accepts all three typed edits without stale actor, trajectory or collision dependencies; unaffected state remains exact and the added clone yields at least 196 new positive collision labels.
falsification_condition: Any V6 edit rejected or false-safe, naive arm not exposed as false-safe, denominator drift, unaffected actor/collision mutation, missing timestamp, non-exact repeat, source mutation, unsupported metric promoted, training, confirmation read or resource breach.
compute_budget: CPU-only 3 edits x 4 arms over 23 actors and 196 timestamps under 120 seconds and 10 GiB free disk; no GPU, training or confirmation read

problem: H-R13-005 verifies typed actor dependency closure but has no rendered sensor or perception evidence. R3 already froze actor-remove-all renders for StreetGS and AD-GS on the same two logged development frames, allowing a bounded test of whether rendered changes are localized to actor support and propagate deterministically into a frozen perception model.
mechanism: For StreetGS and AD-GS at frames 52/57, compare frozen logged and actor-remove-all RGB using each frontend's dilated dynamic-opacity support, then run the frozen Cityscapes DeepLab checkpoint twice on all eight images. Measure target/outside RGB change, locality enrichment, target/outside semantic-label change, repeat exactness and four-arm false-safe accounting.
existing_method_boundary: The R3 scene-0242 rendered edit and H-R13-005 scene-0230 typed compiler test are separate development cases, not an end-to-end identical SceneIR binding. The metric is perception-change locality, not semantic accuracy. No new renderer execution, generation, training, planner or physical collision claim.
minimum_experiment: Two frontends x two frames, logged/edit RGB and 16 deterministic perception inferences over two repeats. Every case must exceed 0.05 target RGB MAE, stay below 0.001 outside RGB MAE and 5% outside changed pixels, achieve at least 50x RGB locality, at least 2% target semantic change, at most 2% outside semantic change and at least 2x semantic locality; V6 false-safe 0 and naive false-safe 1.
expected_direction: Both frontends localize actor-removal RGB effects to actor support and the frozen perception output changes materially inside that support while remaining stable outside it, with exact repeated labels.
falsification_condition: Any of four cases fails locality/perception gates, repeat or source drift, typed dynamic source gate not passed, V6 false-safe, naive false-safe below one, GPU over 4GiB, wall over 300s, unsupported metric promoted, training or confirmation read.
compute_budget: One frozen DeepLab load and 16 inferences on a single RTX 3090 under 4GiB and 300 seconds, plus CPU metrics; no renderer run, training or confirmation read

problem: H-R13-006 proves sensor RGB locality but rejects full-frame perception locality because DeepLab's wide receptive field changes 6.3%-10.3% labels outside the actor support. A factorized verifier may avoid this global coupling by evaluating a frozen high-actor ROI and a disjoint low-actor static ROI independently.
mechanism: On a fixed 256px tile grid with 128px candidate stride, select the maximum logged actor-opacity tile as target and the minimum actor-opacity non-overlapping tile as static, without reading semantic labels. Run the same frozen DeepLab twice on logged/edited versions of both tiles. Preserve the H-R13-006 RGB/perception thresholds but apply them to explicit target versus static factors.
existing_method_boundary: Development ROI-level change locality only. It does not alter, relax or overwrite the rejected full-frame result, does not establish semantic accuracy, and remains separate from the H-R13-005 typed SceneIR case. The only new mechanism is factorized spatial evaluation with pre-registered tile geometry.
minimum_experiment: Two frontends x two frames x target/static x logged/edited x two repeats = 32 inferences. Every case requires target actor fraction >=0.10, static <=0.01, target RGB MAE >=0.05, static RGB MAE <=0.001, RGB enrichment >=50, target label change >=0.02, static label change <=0.02 and perception enrichment >=2; exact repeats and inherited false-safe gates remain mandatory.
expected_direction: Independently evaluated static ROIs remain semantically stable while target ROIs react to actor removal in both frontends and frames, demonstrating the utility of factorized task-specific verification despite the frozen full-frame rejection.
falsification_condition: Any crop denominator/threshold fails, any static ROI changes over 2%, target change below 2%, enrichment below 2, repeat/source drift, source gate mismatch, GPU over 4GiB, wall over 300s, training, confirmation read or unsupported claim.
compute_budget: One frozen DeepLab load and 32 crop inferences on a single RTX 3090 under 4GiB and 300 seconds; no renderer execution, training or confirmation read

problem: The remove-all render used by H-R13-006/007 covers every legal 256px static tile, so spatial factorization cannot create an unaffected control. StreetGS retains per-Gaussian actor model IDs and can render one actor removal while preserving all others, producing a genuinely bounded edit without changing thresholds.
mechanism: From the frozen scene-0242 StreetGS checkpoint, select the model index visible at both frames 52/57 with maximum Gaussian count (ties by smallest index), render logged and only-that-actor-removed outputs, restore checkpoint tensors exactly, and run the frozen DeepLab twice.
